integrity: Proof and complete finite-case reproduction script supplied; 13 independent finite parameter tests (77267 nonzero rank-one maps), not infinite proof. Only a self-review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers only linear rank at most one for univariate truncation length n >= 4, working with the reduced parameter variety. No claims about all higher-rank operators, nonreduced parameter schemes, or automorphism orbits. Publication priority has not been independently certified.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter loci of truncated polynomial algebras
